title: One clock for the game (?time=, ?seed=) and ?open= links into anything
body:
Two review tools, so a link (or the story log's camera) can show any moment and go inside anything.

**The clock** (`src/city/clock.ts`)
- Everything that goes by the date or by chance now asks `now()` / `today()` / `dice(name)` instead of `Date.now()` / `Math.random()`: the garden and its sign, the busker, the boxing bout and its feathers, the dinosaurs, the bike race and Cone Catch. Each `dice` name is its own seeded stream.
- `?time=2026-04-15` (or `…T19:30`) starts the clock at that moment; `?seed=7` makes chance repeat. With neither, nothing changes for visitors.
- Network timing (the relay) and animation frames stay on the real clock.

**`?open=` links** (`src/ui/openLink.ts`, pure + tested)
- `?open=garden`, `?open=boat`, `?open=sundrop`: any target by kind, key or name. It stands you beside it and presses {A} through the same path a visitor's {A} takes (`CityGame.interactWith`; the frame's A-press now calls the same method).
- `scene:<spot id>`, `arcade`, `arcade:<cabinet id>` (goes in as choosing it from GAMES does), `ride:figure8|whirl`, `minigame:cone-catch`, `idea`, `spots`.
- The smoke test opens one of each kind.

**Story log**: `Where:` now takes `open:garden` or a raw query (`?open=garden&time=2026-04-15`), and every photo pins `seed=1` plus the change's merge time, so before and after differ only by the change and the garden shows its month.

Known limit: `?open=crow` finds a street crow first, since the snack crow and the street crows share the name "A crow".

@exit320-stack: heads-up. Links like `gardeninsound.website/?open=sundrop` or `?open=scene:rush-hour` now work on the live site, which is handy for showing someone one thing. New things that go by the time or chance should use `now()` / `dice()` (src/city/CLAUDE.md).

## Story
Idea:
Where: ?open=garden&time=2026-04-15 — the garden sign in April
Asked vs made:
Mike:
Note: Part of a review of how time, scenes, structures and characters work. The garden by month was the first thing it made possible to show.
